globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const variant = globalThis.variant ?? 0;
  const el = document.createElement('div'); const style = el.style;
  const fails = fn => {try {fn(); return false;} catch(error) {return error instanceof TypeError;}};
  const identity = style === el.style && style instanceof CSSStyleDeclaration && style instanceof CSSStyleProperties
    && Object.prototype.toString.call(style) === '[object CSSStyleProperties]';
  const empty = style.length === 0 && style.cssText === '' && style.item(0) === '' && style[0] === undefined
    && style.parentRule === null && style.width === '' && style.unknownProperty === undefined && !el.hasAttribute('style');
  const width = `${variant+1}px`;
  style.width = width; style.height = '20px'; style.setProperty('WIDTH','9px','ImPoRtAnT');
  const mutations = el.getAttribute('style') === 'width: 9px !important; height: 20px;'
    && style.width === '9px' && style.getPropertyPriority('width') === 'important';
  el.setAttribute('style',`height: 10px; width: ${width} !important; width: 3px; bogus: 1; height: nope`);
  const external = style.height === '10px' && style.width === width && style.length === 2
    && style.cssText === `height: 10px; width: ${width} !important;`
    && el.getAttribute('style').endsWith('height: nope');
  const raw = el.getAttribute('style');
  for (const value of ['nope','2px !important','2px; height: 8px']) style.width = value;
  style.setProperty('width','3px','bad'); style.setProperty('unknown','anything');
  for (const name of ['--','--x y','--x; width','--x: height','--x\\0']) style.setProperty(name,'2px');
  const invalid = el.getAttribute('style') === raw && style.width === width;
  style.setProperty('width','4px');
  const overridePriority = style.width === '4px' && style.getPropertyPriority('width') === '';
  style.cssText = 'margin: 1px 2px 3px 4px; padding: 2px;';
  const shorthand = style.margin === '1px 2px 3px 4px' && style.marginTop === '1px'
    && style.marginRight === '2px' && style.marginBottom === '3px' && style.marginLeft === '4px'
    && style.length === 8 && style.cssText === 'margin: 1px 2px 3px 4px; padding: 2px;';
  style.marginLeft = '5px';
  const longhand = style.margin === '1px 2px 3px 5px' && style.marginLeft === '5px';
  style.setProperty('margin-top','6px','important');
  const mixedPriority = style.margin === '' && style.getPropertyPriority('margin') === ''
    && style.getPropertyPriority('margin-top') === 'important';
  const removed = style.removeProperty('padding') === '2px' && style.paddingTop === '' && style.length === 4;
  style.cssText = '--A: one; --a: two; --A: three !important; padding: INHERIT';
  const custom = style.getPropertyValue('--A') === 'three' && style.getPropertyValue('--a') === 'two'
    && style.getPropertyPriority('--A') === 'important' && style.paddingTop === 'inherit';
  style.setProperty('--A','','invalid');
  const emptyRemoval = style.getPropertyValue('--A') === '' && style.getPropertyValue('--a') === 'two';
  style.cssText = 'width: 1px; height: 2px;';
  const indexed = style.length === 2 && style[0] === 'width' && style[1] === 'height'
    && style.item(-1) === '' && style.item(4294967296) === 'width' && style.item(undefined) === 'width'
    && style.item({valueOf(){return 1;}}) === 'height'
    && Object.keys(style).join(',') === '0,1' && '0' in style && !('2' in style)
    && !Reflect.set(style,'0','bad') && !Reflect.defineProperty(style,'1',{value:'bad'})
    && !Reflect.deleteProperty(style,'0') && Reflect.deleteProperty(style,'9');
  style.width = null; style.height = undefined;
  const coercion = style.width === '' && style.height === '2px';
  style.cssText = null;
  const textCoercion = style.cssText === '' && el.getAttribute('style') === '';
  style.setProperty = () => {throw new Error('author override');};
  style.width = '7px'; style.cssFloat = 'left';
  const internal = style.width === '7px' && style.cssFloat === 'left' && style.getPropertyValue('float') === 'left';
  el.style = 'height: 8px';
  const forwarded = style === el.style && style.height === '8px' && style.width === '';
  const getter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'style').get;
  const cssGetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(CSSStyleDeclaration.prototype,'cssText').get;
  const guarded = [() => new CSSStyleDeclaration(), () => new CSSStyleProperties(), () => getter.call({}),
    () => cssGetter.call({}), () => style.getPropertyValue(), () => style.removeProperty(),
    () => CSSStyleDeclaration.prototype.setProperty.call(style,'width'), () => style.item(),
    () => style.item(1n), () => style.item(Object(1n)), () => style.item(Symbol()),
    () => style.getPropertyValue(Symbol()), () => {style.width = Symbol();},
    () => {el.style = Symbol();}].every(fails);
  class NativeStyleElement extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes(){return ['style'];}
    attributeChangedCallback(name,oldValue,newValue){this.changes = (this.changes ?? 0)+1; this.last=newValue;}
  }
  customElements.define(`x-style-${variant}`,NativeStyleElement);
  const customEl=document.createElement(`x-style-${variant}`); customEl.style.width=width;
  const reactions=customEl.changes === 1 && customEl.last === `width: ${width};`;
  el.removeAttribute('style');
  const removal = style === el.style && style.cssText === '' && style.length === 0;
  return {identity,empty,mutations,external,invalid,overridePriority,shorthand,longhand,mixedPriority,removed,
    custom,emptyRemoval,indexed,coercion,textCoercion,internal,forwarded,guarded,reactions,removal};
})();
